K.S.Miracle ran a great race in the Mile 
CS. Afterward, she shared an outpouring of 
emotion with Daitaku Helios, who had run 
alongside her.

It was distinct from the joy of winning—a 
pure feeling of "running and competing is 
fun." Seeing the two of them, Bamboo 
Memory found herself inspired as well.

With a pounding heart full of excitement, 
K.S.Miracle headed toward her next goal, 
the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
